description: Land Acquisition - Ranasinhagama, Haldummulla D/S Division and Guruthalawa, Welimada D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes (official residence and public purpose), including land descriptions, boundaries, claimant information, and compensation procedures. The content focuses solely on land and property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
